output.brief: The fall in first-contact resolution is mainly a billing problem created by Finance's FC-0417 change on 14 April. It cut the maximum in-call credit from £100 to £25 and automatically refers larger billing cases to Billing Resolution. Billing referrals jumped from 7% to 54% that same week. Referred calls resolve about a third of the time; non-referred calls stayed at 82%. The new starters perform the same as experienced agents, so the April intake, the IVR change, workload and the tariff rise are not the cause. Finance was not consulted and the change was marked as needing no training. Next steps: run Lewis Abara's proposed limited trial with Finance (a higher in-call credit limit on two teams, with post-call sampling of credits) and track FCR and unsupported credits. Do not put new starters on performance plans, and do not restore the full limit everywhere yet. I am fairly confident about the link to the Finance change; the complaint link is an association, and I did not check the Finance change's effect on unsupported credits directly.
